free_tier.stated: 1 GB maximum site size on gitlab.com (tied to the 1 GB max artifact size); 200,000 file entries per site; unlimited projects.

egress.terms: No egress charge published; rate limits are 1,000 requests/50s per IP and 5,000 requests/10s per Pages domain — generous enough for real serving but a hard ceiling if sharded heavily onto one domain.

tooling: git push + a `pages` job in .gitlab-ci.yml (a 'pages' artifact); the git-pages v2 API also accepts a direct HTTP upload. No rclone backend.
chaining: 1 GB x unlimited projects x unlimited namespaces. 20 TiB = 20,480 projects. Per-project cap is 2x GitHub Pages but still fails a 500 GB unit test on its own.
limits_note: 1 GB site size and 1 GB max artifact; 200,000 files/dirs/symlinks per site; 150 custom domains; 1000 parallel deployments per top-level namespace; Pages rate limits 1,000 req/50s per IP.
reliability_note: Self-managed default is a 100 MB Pages cap, but gitlab.com is 1 GB — do not confuse the two. CI minutes are free but shared runners now require a card on file for gitlab.com.
